choices.english: 'up to us' for ἐφ᾽ ἡμῖν, always
choices.why: The formula is the debate's technical term (vs fate/nature); 'up to us' preserves it against later systematizing.
Three grades distinguished: externally-moved, nature/soul-moved (self-moved strictly), animal self-movement; rationals move 'through themselves'.

choices.english: takes order into the whole's administration
rejected: is fitted into providence (loses the verb)
choices.term: κατάταξιν λαμβάνειν εἰς τὴν τοῦ παντὸς διοίκησιν
choices.why: katataxis = taking rank/order; freedom is ranked into the whole's dioikesis — the anti-fatalist payoff.
ararotōs = firmly fitted; keeps foreknowledge's certainty distinct from necessitation.
tonos = pitch/tension (Stoic overtone); Paul's godliness has a pitch set before foundation.

lemmas.lexica: LSJ: habit, state; Stoic: stable disposition

pass_a_gloss: Of movables, some have external mover (lifeless by habit; bodies/plants as shifted); second, nature/soul-moved (self-moved strictly); third, animal self-movement; rationals move through themselves; remove it, no animal remains; what follows its own movement must be rational. Deniers of the 'up to us' must deny we are animals or rational; everyone's own affections (willing, eating, walking, assenting) and universal praise/blame practice refute them (servant, son, adulteress). The 'up to us,' with countless turnings, is foreknown from foundation; God predetermines worthily per foreseen movements and sequence — foreknowledge not causing (hypothesis: without foreknowledge we'd still act/will; foreknowledge orders freedom into the whole's administration). Each 'up to us' foreknown → providence dispenses prayer-answers worthily (hear / not hear as unworthy or unprofitable; this prayer yes, that no; the undeceived-God parenthesis on firm/irreversible willing); graduated superabundance; angels assigned/withdrawn; worse power seizes the backslider. Predetermination speeches: Amos-begets-Josiah (1 Kgs 13:2); Judas foreknown in the Son, spoken through David (Ps 108:1); Paul chosen before foundation, set apart from womb (Gal 1:15), permitted persecuting zeal (Acts 7:58) unto unboasting conversion (1 Cor 15:9-10; 2 Cor 12:7).
